intg.intro: The API keys of the email, payment and delivery services installed in this shop.
intg.inactive.title: Saved keys stay off until activated
intg.inactive.body: Keys are stored encrypted. Email and payment providers can be turned on here after their required fields are saved. Delivery keys can be saved and checked; delivery activation arrives later. Saving or checking a key never turns a provider on.
intg.storageDisabled.title: Keys cannot be saved on this server
intg.storageDisabled.body: The server has no encryption key configured (the server variable {variable}). Ask the developer to set it; until then nothing can be saved here.
intg.secret.envNote: The value comes from the server variable {variable}. It is read-only here: it is changed on the server.
intg.secret.needsReentry: The server can no longer read this saved value (its encryption key was changed). Enter the key again.
intg.empty.title: No provider is installed
intg.empty.body: This shop has no email, payment or delivery service that needs a key.
intg.guide.title: How to get the key
intg.guide.resend.step2: In the Resend dashboard, add the domain you send from and publish the DNS records it shows.
intg.guide.resend.step3: In the dashboard, create an API key with sending access. Copy it right away and enter it here as the API key.
intg.guide.resend.webhookSecret: When you create a webhook in the Resend dashboard, it shows a signing secret that starts with whsec_. Enter that value here.
intg.guide.brevo.step2: In the Brevo dashboard, authenticate the domain you send from.
intg.guide.brevo.step3: Create an API key in the dashboard and enter it here. Use the API key, not the SMTP password.
intg.guide.brevo.webhookSecret: Brevo does not issue this value: you create it. Generate a long random token (at least 32 random bytes, only characters that are safe in a web address), put it into the webhook settings in Brevo and enter the same value here. Never reuse the API key for it.
intg.guide.monobank.step1: For a trial, get a test token on the Monobank API site.
intg.guide.monobank.step2: For real payments, create a token in the Monobank business cabinet.
intg.guide.monobank.step3: Enter the token here, then explicitly turn the provider on. The first successful save permanently locks the merchant; every replacement is checked without charging. Monobank needs no separate webhook secret.
intg.guide.liqpay.step2: In the LiqPay cabinet, open the shop API keys. Sandbox and production keys are different.
intg.guide.liqpay.step3: Enter the public and private keys from the same shop. They form one candidate version; the list shows which fields are saved or missing. Check currently reports Unverified; it never creates a payment.
intg.guide.liqpay.publicKey: The public key from the LiqPay cabinet (often starts with sandbox_ or i). Paste it into Public key.
intg.guide.liqpay.privateKey: The private key from the same shop in the LiqPay cabinet. Paste it into Private key. It is never shown again after save.
intg.guide.nova_post.step1: Sign in to the Nova Post business cabinet.
intg.guide.nova_post.step2: Open Settings, then Security, and create an API key.
intg.guide.nova_post.step3: Enter the key and choose an environment if offered. Each saved version keeps its environment. Delivery activation arrives later; a shipping profile and methods are also required. Tracking uses polling without webhook setup.
intg.dialog.enter.title: Enter the key: {field}, {provider}
intg.dialog.enter.description: The key is stored encrypted and is never shown again. It stays off until it is activated.
intg.dialog.replace.title: Replace the saved key: {field}, {provider}
intg.dialog.replace.description: A new candidate version is saved encrypted. Other saved fields of the same bundle are carried forward. The active version keeps working until a new version is activated.
intg.dialog.remove.title: Remove the saved key: {field}, {provider}
intg.dialog.remove.description: All saved fields of this candidate version are removed together. Active and retained versions are kept.
intg.dialog.turnOn.title: Turn on {provider}
intg.dialog.turnOn.description: New operations use the saved candidate. Existing work keeps the version it started with. Replacing an active key requires this activation too.
intg.dialog.turnOff.title: Turn off {provider}
intg.dialog.turnOff.description: Stop new operations with this provider. Existing work, including payment reconciliation and refunds, keeps its saved version until revoked.
intg.dialog.revoke.title: Revoke the key: {field}, {provider}
intg.dialog.revoke.description: Every key in this version is revoked locally and cannot be used again. Work already bound to it may need manual recovery. Revoke the key at the provider separately.
intg.dialog.valueHint: Paste it exactly as the service shows it. Spaces around it are dropped.
intg.dialog.passwordHint: Asked for every change of a key.
intg.error.passwordIncorrect: The password is not correct. Nothing was changed.
intg.error.value.invalid_characters: The key contains a space or a character a key cannot have. Paste it again.
intg.error.value.invalid_format: This does not look like a key of this service. Check that you copied the right value.
intg.refusal.integration_storage_disable: The server has no encryption key configured, so nothing can be saved.
intg.refusal.integration_env_override: The server already sets this, so it cannot be changed or turned on here.
intg.refusal.integration_revision_stale: The integrations were changed in the meantime. Nothing was changed: try again.
intg.refusal.integration_unavailable: This service's module could not be loaded on the server, so nothing was saved. Tell the developers.
intg.refusal.integration_version_not_ret: This saved value can no longer be removed. Reload the page to see the current state.
intg.refusal.integration_runtime_not_rea: This provider cannot be activated here yet.
intg.refusal.integration_sender_required: Email cannot be turned on until the server has a sender address.
intg.refusal.integration_route_unset: Only Resend and Brevo can be on together. Turn the other email provider off first.
intg.refusal.integration_not_activatable: Save all required outbound fields before turning this provider on.
intg.refusal.integration_not_enabled: This provider is already off. Nothing was changed.
intg.refusal.integration_version_not_rev: This saved key can no longer be revoked. Reload the page to see the current state.
intg.refusal.step_up_unavailable: The password cannot be checked safely right now. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
intg.refusal.rateLimited: Too many password checks. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
intg.refusal.rateLimitedWait: Too many password checks. Nothing was changed. Try again in {minutes} min.
intg.route.title: How new mail is shared
intg.route.equalBody: Of 100 new messages, about 50 start with Resend and 50 with Brevo whenever both are in the send chain, including a chain set on the server. A message waits while its starting provider is cooling down. It moves to the other only after a definite non-acceptance. A timeout or a rejected message stays where it is.
intg.route.resendBody: Every new message starts with Resend whenever Resend is in the chain. It waits while Resend is cooling down. Brevo is used only after Resend has definitely not accepted that message. A timeout or a rejected message is not sent through Brevo.
intg.notice.saved: The key is saved. It stays off until it is activated.
intg.notice.turnedOn: The provider is on. New operations use the saved version.
intg.notice.turnedOff: The provider is off for new operations. Existing work keeps its saved version.
intg.notice.routeSaved: New mail now follows this choice.
intg.notice.stale: The integrations were changed in the meantime. Nothing was changed and the list is reloaded: try again.
intg.notice.unknown: The server did not answer, so the change may or may not have happened. The list is reloaded: check the state before you repeat it.
intg.version.title: Version {generation}
intg.check.ok: The check succeeded for this version at the time shown. It does not activate the key.
intg.check.invalid_credentials: This version was refused. Check the saved keys and replace them if needed.
intg.check.unavailable: The provider could not be checked now. Try again later.
intg.check.rate_limited: The check limit was reached. Wait before trying again.
intg.check.not_supported: Unverified: this provider does not offer a supported check. This does not mean the key is invalid.
intg.check.failed: The check could not finish. Retry Check; reload the page if the version has changed.
intg.dialog.environmentHint: Choose the environment for this saved version. Changing it requires saving the key again and creates a new version.
intg.dialog.environmentLocked: This environment is set on the server and cannot be changed here.
intg.refusal.integration_credential_chec: The credential could not be checked safely. Nothing was saved. Try again later.
intg.refusal.invalid_credentials: The provider refused this credential. Check it and enter it again.
intg.refusal.integration_merchant_mismat: This key belongs to a different merchant. Enter a replacement key from the merchant enrolled on the first save.
intg.refusal.integration_merchant_not_en: Save the key again to verify its merchant before activation.
intg.refusal.integration_legacy_work_ope: Existing payments still need the server key. Finish or reconcile them before switching to stored credentials.
intg.refusal.integration_currency_unsupp: This provider does not support the shop currency.
intg.refusal.integration_public_url_requ: Set a public storefront URL on the server before activating payments.
intg.refusal.integration_payment_window_: The order payment window must be at least 8 minutes before online payments can be activated. Ask the developer to update the server settings.
